ui.d398ae18ddb4: Kudala iseshini ohlangothini lweseva; akukho ucingo lwe-PSTN oluthiwa lwenzekile ngaphandle kokuthi inkampani yezokuxhumana ithumele lo mcimbi ku-webhook evikelekile.
ui.07ddb7f340fd: I-IVR: Cindezela u-1 uma kunephutha, u-2 ukuze uthole isikhathi sokuhlangana, u-3 ukukhuluma nomsizi wosizo.
ui.8ef964729e07: Ithatha ucingo oludala kunazo zonke ekulayini bese iluthumela kumsizi ongcono okhona (ukufaniswa kwamakhono, bese kulandelwa isikhathi eside sokulinda). Kuyisinqumo sokwabela kuphela — akusho ukuthi kunoxhumano lwangempela locingo.
ui.43db61570404: Ibalazwe lisebenzisa i-Leaflet nedatha ephilayo ye-/v1/gis/fleet. Awekho amaphuzu ezimoto akhiwe yi-UI.
ui.17a1e3ec5d4a: Ikhamera nesiphequluli kuthwebula ubufakazi ngokwasendaweni. Amakhoodineythi avela ku-GPS, futhi ubufakazi bungabe sebuthunyelwa kuseva kusetshenziswa ithikithi elivunyelwe.
ui.06fa943be019: Ukuhlelwa kunqunywa ngokugxile: ubuphuthumi be-SLA + ukufaniswa kwamakhono + ibanga + umthwalo womsebenzi. Iseva iyigunya lokwabela.
ui.f1a80e3e8395: Lesi asiyona isikrini sokuhlobisa kuphela. Uhlu olungezansi lwakhiwe ngokususela kusiqondiso se-HTML esinamathiselwe, futhi luhlela isici ngasinye ngokususela kubufakazi bokusetshenziswa okukhona ku-repository. Igama lesici alisho ukuthi isici siphelele.
ui.1e22c22f5622: Ukufundwa kwamabhuku emali kuvela ku-PostgreSQL kuphela. Awekho umphathi omkhulu we-AI ozimele, awukho umsebenzi wezimali ozimele, futhi awekho imiphumela elingiswayo ethulwa njengeqiniso.

ui.ddf413a199e7: Lesi sithombe asakhi izinombolo: uma i-API/DB ingatholakali, sibonisa isimo esingatholakali esikhundleni sedatha yamanga.
ui.fe1b878224ed: Umsebenzi wangempela wasendaweni: ikhamera + OCR + GPS + ubufakazi + ukuvalwa ngegunya leseva. Ayikho idatha ye-GPS/inombolo ehlala njalo enikezwayo.
